description: Ministry of Home Affairs and Fisheries - Order to declare 14.01.2015 as a special Public and Bank Holiday
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a special public and bank holiday under the authority of the Holidays Act, No. 29 of 1971. This constitutes a regulatory action, specifically the creation of a subsidiary regulation under existing legislation. While a minister is named, the core purpose is not about government personnel or structure but about establishing a legal/regulatory framework for a holiday, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
